label: Bootstrap repository state from the legacy Entry Space

execute.description: bootstrap repository state from the legacy Entry Space
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."repository_state" ("meta_space_id", "singleton_id") SELECT "id", 1 FROM "public"."spaces" WHERE "entry" = TRUE LIMIT 1

postcheck.description: verify every non-empty repository has singleton state
postcheck.sql: SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."spaces") OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."repository_state" WHERE "singleton_id" = 1)) AS "result"
